review.imagery: Sixteen native-resolution project renders from the original Wasl brochure were visually reviewed. Tower A/B lobby and residence distinctions follow the brochure. Typical and duplex interiors retain their scope. Dated construction photographs were not established. Card and hero use the owned exterior image. No card badges.
review.floorPlans: All 29 residence sheets retain the visible final area panels and original notices. Repeated type names refer to different source sheets. Duplex totals cover the whole home once. Source arithmetic, malformed suite text on page 7 and factsheet-range differences remain qualified. A private pool is specified only for 3 BR duplex units 2305, 2505 and 2705. Confirm the selected unit with Wasl. All 29 visible final numerical panels were reviewed. Masked/duplicated engineering text in the PDF includes unrelated stale values, so source pixels determine the displayed figures. Published totals are preserved, including page 4 at 1,503.72 sq ft versus the 1,505.66 component sum. Source notices and whole sheets remain intact.
review.location: The full original regional brochure map and all five published community estimates were visually checked. The official embed labels Avenue Park Towers Building B without a phase-specific visitor-entrance coordinate. Named phase directions are used without treating the camera centre as a verified project pin.
review.provenance: Current official HTML, brochure, factsheet, residence-plan and floorplate PDFs are cached with SHA-256 and source metadata. Residence-plan drawing variants are identified by physical PDF page. All original protected identities and commercial qualifications remain intact.

unavailable: A phase-specific verified visitor-entrance coordinate, dated construction photographs and reconciled contractual unit areas were not established. Original numerical and factsheet-range conflicts remain explicit.
